description: A Minecraft mod that adds customizable timestamps to chat!

mods.name: Plague's Chat Timestamps
mods.description: This mod adds customizable timestamps to chat!

mods.name: Plague's Chat Timestamps
mods.description: This mod adds customizable timestamps to chat!

releases.notes:
# 1.3.33

- Minecraft 26.3 support
- Changing the settings now also updates the timestamps of messages already in chat
- Timestamps no longer change or repeat upon chat refreshing
- The chat log no longer includes the timestamp
- Invalid timestamp format no longer crashes the game, config screen rejects it instead
- Also invalid/broken config file will revert to defaults instead of crashing
- Fabric version will no longer crash when opening the config without cloth config install, cloth config is now suggested
- In hover mode, fallback to prefixing the timestamp on messages that can not display the timestamp on hover
